Batch crawl stream emits both Page and Error events for mixed success/failure URLs

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { batchCrawlStream, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { maxConcurrent: 1 };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const urls = ["https://example.com/success1", "https://example.com/fail", "https://example.com/success2"];
  const result = await batchCrawlStream(engine, urls);
  for await (const resultChunk of result) {
    console.log(resultChunk);
  }
}

void main();
```
